entry.title: Hochosterwitz Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected aerial picture supports pale summit wings, dark slate roofs, round turrets, entry tower and descending walls/gates. Retained east/south map geometry sets approximate location, scale and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply the hill; the derivative translates the old611.9699m first-gate study datum to the703.9600882109237m anchor datum, uses one retained PMTiles sampler for walls/routes at every level and raises reconstructed gate/summit floors only enough to clear coarse ground. No terrain mesh is embedded in the architecture. Anchor 14.452350896,46.755908856; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 703.9600882109237m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
